english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something gives off its own light.
Use this when a source emits or gives off light, rather than when “shed light on” means explain something.
Use this for something emitting or reflecting bright light rather than actually burning.
Use this when something emits light or visibly glows.

examples.english: The lamp shed light in the darkness.

examples.english: The sign begins to blaze with light as soon as it is switched on.
